status_definitions.VERIFIED_OFFICIAL: Seen on the lender's own page in this session (snippet or fetch).
status_definitions.VERIFIED_SECONDARY: Seen only on a comparison/third-party page; used as hard rule but flagged.
status_definitions.OBSERVED_IN_CALCULATOR: Calculator description evidence; no numeric value.
status_definitions.CONFLICTING: Sources disagree, unresolved; engine will not use the value.

global_affordability_assumption.method: S02 (secondary) says most banks/NBFCs cap total EMIs at 50-60% of net income; 0.50 chosen conservatively.
global_affordability_assumption.use: Estimate max loan only for lenders with no published ratio. Never a rejection threshold; raises a warning only.

amount_calculation: max_amount = min(published amount_max if known, PV(headroom EMI, rate_max, permitted tenure)); headroom = cap*income - existing EMI. rate_max used (conservative) since applicant rate unknown; if rate unknown, only published cap shown.
